source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: My name is Alex M.. I am 20 years old. I’m studying children development in Istanbul University. I’ve been playing PUBG for 3 years. I think I have been playing Metro Royale mode actively for 1 or 1,5 years. Is there anything you want to ask?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I am actively playing PUBG. I used to play some other games but because of my university and social groups, I play PUBG with my cousins and my friends.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I love shooter games in general. I prefer shooter games. I think the others are not appealing to me. I am not going to lie. We like shooter games as a family. When we played other different games, they were not fun. But with this one, we are competing each other in terms of how many kills we have etc.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I played many of them but I don’t remember their names because I played them for a short time and I quit. I used to play on my computer. Because I get bored so easily. I don’t remember their names. But since my childhood, I used to play CS. I started playing it when I was 4 years old. Before this meeting, I confirmed a game but I can’t remember its game. I’m sorry.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: At home. Thanks to my father, we started playing CS. He likes computer games. Since my childhood, I had always games on my computer. We started CS with my sister which was very fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Usually I play strategically. I also camp a lot.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes but sometimes brave heartedly I run towards to enemy as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. I’m focused on the result so what matters is killing the enemy.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I am fierce. I am a competitive person.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Since I am focused on the result, these games affect me more. When I am competing, I check the results and merit points at the end. These are positive for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I like ranking games as well but I play classic modes in general. General ones.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: You already rank up from your kills. In general, I am focused not to lose the game. If I lose the game, my rank is not go up. All results in the same.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Are you talking about PUBG or in general?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It would differ from game to game but the same for me. Because the things I could do with the shooter is limited. I either do camping or go ahead and shoot the person.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: If it was automatic, it would be different but it’s like that in shooter.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, it differs from game to game. Maps are different. If I am familiar with the map, it’s different than a map that I am not familiar with. If I know the map, I can anticipate the locations that my enemies can pop up. In well-known maps, you can hunt them down easily.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I focus on the scope. The scope level is very important. I can easily see a very distant enemy with 8 times scope. If my scope zooms only 2 times, I cannot see the enemy. The most important thing for me is the scope.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I’ve started with my two fingers then I used my four fingers. Sometimes, it’s more than 6 fingers. Sometimes 5-6 fingers but in general 4 fingers now.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I don’t. If there is a new notice in the game, I may check it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: For instance, in Erangel mode, the normal mode. There is a shopping bag icon.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: No. I prefer the weapons that I am used to. I also see the new weapons in game and try them. If I don’t like it, I change it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. My friends or my cousins.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I play with them. They play weird games and I don’t like them. They don’t play games with weapons. I delete the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: As I know that I will improve myself. I can be e-sport gamer. Did you mean it?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: If I compare them, CS has more limited weapons. But I use different weapons in PUBG. In CS, I play as first person. In PUBG, you can play both as first person and third person. I generally prefer third person and I think I can focus better. Also, the number of players or players on the plane changes. There is no such thing in CS. You can see the number of players but not as much as PUBG.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I can navigate easily.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: When I open the scope, it’s easier to open when I prone, I can see the environment easily. But in different shooter games, I need to check environment by turning around. In PUBG, you can see your environment with your eyes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. Even I run, I can see my back and I still keep running towards to the same direction. It’s really important for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I heard. But I remember that I played it once and I didn’t like it. I know its name.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: My friends were playing this near me. I was curious about it and I downloaded it to my phone. But I deleted it and I didn’t try it. But when my friends were playing, I assume I watched them. I guess I played once. But I cannot recall it well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I want a different game experience. When they were playing, I thought if we could play together. I downloaded it but I didn’t even enter it. I deleted it immediately.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Because I assume I cannot break out of my habits. I want to proceed the way that I know and I am used to. If I pass to another game, I may have a break in PUBG. I want to rank up in PUBG. If I pass to another game, I will lose my efforts on PUBG. Therefore, I cannot think of any other game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: If I wasn’t thinking about improving my rank in PUBG, I would love to try Tarkov. But I know my habits, I will be obsessed to this game and I would want to improve myself in this game. Therefore, I wouldn’t want to give up my aims.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I have some friends who don’t play PUBG but this. My aim was to spend time with them. Therefore, I downloaded it. But then I deleted it because I thought they should download PUBG and we can play together.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: But now I have more virtual friends, friends from the game. I prefer playing with my friends with who I can improve my rank. Not with the friends from real world.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I have also friends from the real world. I have my cousins. They are also really good. Some of them are much better than me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I don’t think they would start but if they did, I would continue on my path. This is my current thought. I don’t know what I will do then.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Curiosity. I explored Metro Royale 1,5 years ago. I wanted to look at it and started. I also drew my friends towards Metro Royale.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Actually it’s different from the normal Erangel mode. In Erangel, you have to seek out for the helmet. But there is an advantage in Metro Royale which is also disadvantage for some. You can seize another person’s helmet or weapon. It may be bad for the opponent but it’s good for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. Also the map is different from Erangel.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Entering the game was very slow. In the beginning, when I was trying to understand the game, I wasn’t so immersed. I tried two times. It was the third time that I was a little ambitious. I told myself that I am going to win this game and I continued.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Playing the game, in the beginning, I wasn’t so immersed because they would throw a weapon over my head and I would die. In Erangel mode, they cannot throw weapon at you. They can only hit you with pans. But in this mode, you can throw anything. I died two times and then I got ambitious. I was surprised when a gun was thrown at me and I was killed. I learned that’s how it goes and I continued.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Daily? It will be much if I say yearly.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: My current account is 3 years old. But I had another accounts before that. I changed my phone and lost them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I can now but my previous phone was Android and I switched to IOS. I couldn’t transfer it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: A lot. I cannot think of hours…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Every day. I spare time in the evening during school days. I spend maximum 2,5 hours. On holidays, I play 5-6 hours without stop.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: If I don’t have exams, I can play more than 5-6 hours. Even I can play until the morning. For instance, if I start playing at 9 pm in the evening, I sometimes play for 12-13 hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In general, with the team. But I prefer playing solo rather than playing with the people that I don’t know in order not to my rank down.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: There are some features that I like but there are also some features that I don’t like. It bans easily. I have some friends get banned even though they did nothing. It’s strange in terms of ban.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: An emulator player cannot play Metro Royale but in Erangel, there are lots of emulator players. Regarding the features I like…I am really good at that mode because I know the map very well. I feel comfortably when I play. I have more possibility to kill more and reach to higher ranks.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Often Metro Royale. If I play Battle Royale, I do two matches.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: 60% Metro Royale, 40% normal mode.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I don’t know the game much but I can give 6 as it didn’t attract me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It’s really different than other games. Would it be okay if I compare it with the normal mode?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In normal mode, only I can play with the weapon even that I developed myself if I find it in the game. But in Metro Royale, I can use my own weapon which is a big advantage for me. I can earn money by selling the products I have obtained and earned in the game on the black market. If you ask this to a normal person, probably she would say it’s normal but it’s extraordinary for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I improve my gun and I have it as soon as I start the game. It’s appealing to me because I don’t have to search for it. In terms of scope, The Erangel mode doesn’t have night vision but Metro Royale has it. They are important factors for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Of course, it’s going to be result-oriented but plundering someone else’s gun is much more appealing to me. In terms of the game, you get something that someone has worked hard for from someone. The fact that you can become the bad guy here which is something you can’t do in real life…I can’t do it in real life. Becoming hijacker is a nice thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: At first I was ambitious but now I am more result-oriented. My gun was also taken away and I was furious. But now it seems normal to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In terms of gunfight, Metro Royale is way better. Sometimes you need to go all around the map just to find a gunfight but when we enter the game together as a team, there is more actions compared to the Erangel mode. Because sometimes everyone has the same capacity and does something for his own team.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Maybe in the future, my aim is to join an e-sport.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, I want to be better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I didn’t have this improvement aim at the beginning. I was just spending some time. But as I grow up, my ideas have changed as well. Now, I am fully focused on the result. I want to improve myself.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: My teammates increase my motivation. When I play with them, I know that I can get better or I know that they won’t pull me down which is a motivation for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I am not sure if it is related to my internet connection but I think it’s about the game. There are lags in the game. And not for the moment but in the past, when it was updating, it held too huge amount capacity of my storage. The same when updating the whole game now. But if I only update Metro Royale mode, it doesn’t hold too much space. This is very important for me. I don’t want to fill my storage on my mobile phone. Also, as I mentioned, there is also lots of banning issues. It doesn’t allow cheats but they can’t eliminate people who cheat on the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. Normally, the game doesn’t allow emulator but there are so many people playing emulator.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: My friend experienced something. A level 1 gamer can take my gun. This is really a disadvantage. If I experience this, I might feel distant to the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: If I improve a weapon and it takes long time, if I get really furious, maybe I quit temporarily. I have an aim. I can’t give up that easily.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I saw it but never questioned it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Should I compare normal mode with Metro Royale?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Normal mode can be boring after a certain point. But Metro Royale makes you more competitive. You can improve yourself in Metro Royale mode. In Erangel mode, Royale Pass matters more. When someone kills you, it doesn’t say you killed him. But in Metro Royale, people can see your level of equipment, they might think that you are someone important, a good player.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I think you can apply this shooting but in classic mode, shooting is more applicable in Metro Royale. There are so many mountains that you can camp there and snipe down people. They never see you. But in other mode, you can also camp in the mountains and you can see lots of people. In Metro Royale, this is more limited.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In Metro Royale, people like play short distance. They shoot from closer range. But in the other mode, everybody is camping.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. Shorter ranges are not shooter for me. If you use automatic rifle, you can kill person without aiming.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It was similar to the normal mode. I’ve already told you I guess but in Metro Royale, you can see it on black market.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I sell it and get money. And with that money, I can buy something for myself or I can buy stuff for my inventory. In normal mode, you have to search out in game. I sell what I loot which has more options.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, definitely. I haven’t heard such black market feature in other game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I can say something but it’s not for Metro Royale, it will be for normal mode. You can be more free in normal mode. You have resurrection feature in normal mode but you don’t have that in Metro Royale.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. They can also put it in this mode.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: There are limited freedom options in game. If I can play on any map, that’s a freedom for me. Or going to point A to B is freedom for me. If you are not plundered by anyone, you can be free.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. As I only play by focusing on myself, I cannot think of anyone else. I know it’s being selfish but it’s the rule of game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. It’s beneficial for me and I want to do it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It is not important if you aim to kill people. If you know how to kill without aiming, you choose your weapon accordingly. But sometimes I shoot without aiming, I use more bullets to kill but I kill eventually.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It has both advantages and disadvantages. The advantages, you may kill the enemy. But the disadvantage, you may shoot a couple times but you kill eventually.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Actually, aiming is more important for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In Metro Royale, you kill the enemy somehow but what matters is not to be killed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. But in classic mode, it is important to get as many kills as possible. It doesn’t important if you die.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I don’t check results that much. Otherwise I feel more selfish.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. This is also available in PUBG. You can heal yourself and save your friends. Even lately, you can throw a kit in order to heal your friend. I don’t know if Tarkov has the same feature but it’s a good thing. You can save yourself.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It’s much advantage. Before the resurrection thing, when I have low health, I use the kit on my own and you don’t need anyone’s help.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Similar. In Metro Royale, you can also search them even if you don’t have them in your backpack. You can use your energy drink. You can heal yourself.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In order to do that, I need to research the game a little.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I upgrade my weapon and I feel that I can kill more, I can progress more.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Actually like I said, there are many e-sport games but it is important if there is continuity for the game. When I get interested in e-sport on PUBG, as I research it, I get more interested.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Also, some e-sport games are limited but in PUBG, there are so many tournaments. That’s why it’s more appealing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: They are all important factors but it has to keep me going.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Well, since they are classic factors for me, I don’t feel that immersed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: That’s also effective but not very dominant factor right now. The immersion is what I achieve in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It’s important for my future goals.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Sometimes it’s fun but normally I’m more inclined to realism. I think very differently from other friends. To me, realism is much more important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Because I keep doing the same thing. Maybe trying out new thing would be good. Maybe I won’t be successful but it would be nice to try.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It could add another perspective.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Metro Royale actually speaks to my ideal version. I cannot think of any other type because I don’t know much about these games. I don’t want to say something wrong.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: There will be a new feature in Erangel mode. I am not sure if it has already launched. There will be subways and players can go to anywhere they want to go. But I didn’t see anything else like subway in Metro Royale. It’s a disadvantage. But classic mode is really a classic. As this mode is much different, I cannot compare them. They can add something to Erangel mode from Metro Royale mode.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: No. Only map is different.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: They can put some shopping places on my way so that I can purchase missing things. This is something I can do in Erangel mode but Metro Royale mode doesn’t offer it. Maybe some frequent shopping places would be better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, for instance, I want to purchase clothing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I think it’s appropriate.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes, actually clothing is very important. I have lots of clothing in my inventory. I change my clothing all the time and it’s very important. When we a player with a normal clothing, we say it’s bot.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: We have some tasks and we can also earn money. Or when you update the game, it gives gift. It gives clothing or in game money. We don’t earn money only with looting. As you complete tasks, you can earn more money.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: I also purchased things with money before. I purchase Royal Pass. In general, I purchase clothing or skins for weapons. I pay for these.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: It is okay if it is not but I pay. Because as I want to improve myself, I want to improve my character.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In game or out of the game?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In game loots are very important for gameplay. Out of the game, I assume you’re talking about gift boxes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: In general, I get the things from gift boxes that I want. Or classic boxes or premium boxes. As all are the things that I aim…Clothing, weapons, skins for the plane or vehicles…They attract me. When I pay, I want to open boxes all the time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: When you purchase Royal Pass, you can get beautiful things from boxes. Or based on your luck. In general you get weapons or silver coins. I can get a good thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D8-英文原版
text: Yes. Even if you don’t pay, game gives you boxes or coupon after a while. It’s very good think that a person who don’t pay can open boxes.
